_comment: v002 RE-RUN WITH ITS TWO UNPHYSICAL ADVANTAGES REMOVED, ranging quality UNCHANGED. v002 scored -0.19 dB / 4.8 mm at 2.1 GHz, but it had (a) delayCal identically ZERO, i.e. a perfectly calibrated transponder turn-around and antenna phase centre, and (b) measurements.isl.product ABSENT, which leaves product.enable false and makes ISLMeasurementBuilder consume the neighbour's EXACT TRUTH position and clock (audit defect D21) -- the crosslink prediction knew where the neighbour really was. This run keeps sigma_m = 0.001 m (mm ranging) and changes ONLY those two, so the delta isolates how much of v002's coherence came from ranging precision versus from the two advantages.
_realism: R-1..R-10 unchanged from max_realism_G5S6R4_ts3600.json: realistic caesium clock, IGS-RTS tower product sigma, C/N0 code weighting, multipath/hardware/PCV/survey/DCB truth systematics, relativistic clock, honest measurement floors, luni-solar and SRP in both truth and estimator force families, EOP/solid-Earth tide, inter-antenna carrier bias.
_change3_mmIsl: CHANGE #3 -- mm-class two-way ISL with a CALIBRATED turnaround delay. sigma_m 0.01 -> 0.001 m, and the per-link hardware delay-calibration bias driven to zero. This is a HARDWARE assumption, not a self-calibration: only 3 of the 15 per-link bias DOF are observable in the per-epoch range-residual space and the arc opens up no more, so delayCal.estimate cannot deliver it (it was measured to move the answer by 8 micrometres). It implies a carrier-derived rather than code-derived crosslink observable plus ground/hardware delay calibration.

multiAsset._change2_beamLock: CHANGE #2 -- ground beam-pointing lock. Reads the beam's mispointing on the ground and inverts for a rigid formation rotation, which is EXACTLY the 2 tilt DOF of the mean-removed path error (an injected pure rigid rotation projects onto the tilt subspace with fraction 1.00000000). spotSigma_m is dropped 500 -> 200 m because the measured lock noise-transfer law is linear -- excess path error = 1.24e-5 * spotSigma_m, floor ~0.42 mm -- and at the 500 m default the 2.1 GHz chain fails. 200 m is 10.1 percent of the 1976 m footprint at 2.1 GHz.
